name: Yuki no Nioi to Kaze no Iro
original_name: 雪のにおいと風のいろ
source:
The last school weeks of three boys and three girls. Soon they will be blown apart. But while there is still time, there's a perfect opportunity to create memories for the future.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三名男生与三名女生在学校度过的最后几周。他们很快便会各奔东西，但趁着时间尚存，正好可以创造值得留待未来回忆的往事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
